_comment: MostWanted's game server, for Raptor (or any Pterodactyl/Pelican panel). Import it on the Eggs page. Its files come from server/install.sh, not from this egg: see docs/12-launch.md.
name: MostWanted
author: contact@xenastudios.co
description: The MostWanted game server: Leaf with our plugins and configs. The install does nothing on purpose, so a reinstall never swaps Leaf for another jar: server/install.sh puts the files in, and start.sh starts it. https://github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nothing to download: server/install.sh fills this server from the MostWanted repo
# (docs/12-launch.md, step 5). Doing nothing here means Reinstall can't replace Leaf.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "MostWanted: run server/install.sh on the node to put the server's files in."
